method: Incremental source-contract review of 80 forward and 90 adversarial preserved effective written answers against the frozen v4 skills, by two independent reviewers; 12 new worldbook written scenario answers were authored separately from the expected criteria and independently assessed. The first review passed 11; one focused revision was independently re-reviewed, yielding 12 final passes. Initial answers, finding and revision are retained. Historical runs are unchanged. 2026-10-18 review-fixes re-review: all prior cases were rechecked for source compatibility after the privacy, STScript/API and Skill-publishing fixes, and two routing-ownership cases were added from that review. Not 182 new model trials, installed host discovery, actual SillyTavern, dots execution, or driver acceptance.
